meta.coverage_caveat: entry snapshots are only logged while NO position is held; the counterfactual universe inside the final minutes is therefore conditioned on the policy not holding (60 of 112 closes had a position)
meta.execution_model: sol_v1.side_levels/walk depth-weighted for lot 10 (partial allowed, never beyond displayed) + 1 tick; Kalshi taker fee ceil-to-cent per order; absent side => no fill
meta.how_to_read: net_c = realised net c/contract buying `side` at the depth-weighted executable price + tick and HOLDING to settlement, averaged over every evaluation snapshot (~2 s) in the state; SE clustered by 15-min close; verdict needs >= 20 closes and |t| >= 2; 'scope' says which closes. Nothing here is a trading rule; the search over 357 conditions found no Bonferroni/SPA survivor (see conditions_search.json).
meta.drift_warning: YES settled 38.4% of 112 closes (first half 41.1%, second half 35.7%); SOL index 102.23 -> 94.97 over the sample. Every side-literal 'favourable' (NO) / 'unfavourable' (YES) verdict is consistent with this drift; side-symmetric states are the ones to read.
